dogecoin.text: @GregStocks5 @morningshowca Also, educate me. What do I need to understand about dogecoin being a good investment?

@GregStocks5 @morningshowca There is calculated risk and then there is a gamble. I can't in good faith tell people that putting $$ in #dogecoin is an 'investment' because it is not. The boomer saving mentality - if that is what you are accusing me of - will always win for the everyday saver. Slow & steady.
